def find_missing(arr):
  # sort the array
  arr.sort()
  
  # iterate through the array 
  # to find the smallest positive integer not present 
  for i in range(len(arr)):
    if arr[i] > 0:
      if arr[i+1] != arr[i] + 1:
        return arr[i] + 1
  return arr[-1] + 1

  });

    return arr[mid];

def quick_sort(arr): 
    if len(arr) <= 1:
        return arr
    else:
        pivot = arr[len(arr) // 2]
        left = [x for x in arr if x < pivot]
        middle = [x for x in arr if x == pivot]
        right = [x for x in arr if x > pivot]
        return quick_sort(left) + middle + quick_sort(right)

{ 
    // Random variable 
    Random rand = new Random(); 

    for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++) 
    { 
        // Choose a random index 
        int index = rand.Next(i, array.Length); 

        // Swap 
        int temp = array[i]; 
        array[i] = array[index];

def longest_common_prefix(arr_of_dictionaries):
    prefix = ''
    if len(arr_of_dictionaries) == 0:
        return prefix
    first_dict_keys = arr_of_dictionaries[0].keys()
    for i in range(len(list(first_dict_keys)[0])):
        char = list(first_dict_keys)[0][i]
        for dict in arr_of_dictionaries:
            if list(dict.keys())[0][i] != char:
                return prefix
        prefix += char
    return prefix

"""
Implement a binary search on a given array
"""

def binary_search(arr, element):
    start = 0
    end = len(arr) - 1
    while start <= end:
        mid = (start + end)//2
        if arr[mid] == element:
            return True
        elif arr[mid] < element:
            start = mid + 1
        else:
            end = mid - 1
    return False

if __name__ == '__main__':

    """
    Implementation of the Bubble Sort algorithm.
    """
    for i in range(len(arr)-1):

                arr[j], arr[j+1] = arr[j+1], arr[j]

def caesar_cipher(text, key):
    """Cipher a given text using the Caesar Cipher."""
    ciphertext = ""
    for char in text: 
        if not char.isalpha():
            ciphertext += char
            continue
        offset = ord('a') if char.islower() else ord('A')
        new_char = (ord(char) - offset + key) % 26
        ciphertext += chr(offset + new_char)
    return ciphertext

def binarySearch(arr, element):
    start = 0;
    end = len(arr) - 1
    
    while start <= end:
        mid = (start + end) // 2

        elif arr[mid] < element:
            start = mid + 1
        else:
            end = mid - 1

int LCS(string X, string Y, int m, int n)
{
    int L[m + 1][n + 1];
    int i, j;

    for (i = 0; i <= m; i++)
    {
        for (j = 0; j <= n; j++)
        {
            if (i == 0 || j == 0)
                L[i][j] = 0;
            else if (X[i - 1] == Y[j - 1])
                L[i][j] = L[i - 1][j - 1] + 1;
            else
                L[i][j] = max(L[i - 1][j], L[i][j - 1]);
        }
    }

    return L[m][n];
}

        return []

    left_arr = [x for x in arr if x < pivot]

def binary_search(arr, x):
    left = 0
    right = len(arr) - 1
    
    while left <= right:
        mid = (left + right) // 2
        if arr[mid] == x:
            return mid
        elif arr[mid] < x:
            left = mid + 1
        else:
            right = mid - 1
    return -1

      return mid 
    elif arr[mid] < target:

def find_gcd(x,y):
   
    # If x is greater than y
    # Swapping the x and y
    if x > y:
        tmp = x
        x = y
        y = tmp

    while y > 0:
        tmp = y
        y = x % y
        x = tmp
    return x

class Node{
    int data; 
    Node next; 
        
    Node(int d){
        data = d; 
        next = null; 
    } 
} 

class LinkedList{ 
    Node head; 
        
    public void insert(int data){ 
        Node node = new Node(data); 
        if (head == null) { 
            head = node; 
        } 
        else { 
            Node n = head; 
            while (n.next != null) { 
                n = n.next; 
            } 
            n.next = node; 
        } 
    } 
}
